simple.meaning: properly, a breathing creature , i.e. animal of (abstractly) vitality ; used very widely in a literal, accommodated or figurative sense (bodily or mental)
simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to נֶפֶשׁ (H5315) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: n-f.
simple.whyItMatters: This word appears 757 times in the Hebrew Bible, so BibleIQ can compare how Scripture uses it across multiple passages.

definitions.full: H5315. nephesh נֶ֫פֶשׁ 756 noun feminine Gen 49:6 (so even 2:19 ; Num 31:28 ; 1Kin 19:2 see Albr ZAW xvi (1896), 42 SS) soul, living being, life, self, person, desire, appetite, emotion, and passion (Ecclus 3:18; 4:1 (twice in verse); Eccl 4:2 (twice in verse); Ecclesiasticus 13:12; Ecclesiasticus 14:11); — ׳נ Gen 1:20 +; נָ֑פֶשׁ 37:21 +; suffix נַפְשִׁי 12:13 +; plural נְפָשׁוֺת Ezek 13:18 13 t.; נְפָשֹׁת Exod 12:4 ; Lev 27:2 ; construct נַפְשׁוֺת Gen 36:6 4 t.; נַפְשֹׁת Lev 21:11 ; נְפָשִׁים Ezek 13:20 (but read חָפְשִׁים , see Co Berthol Toy); suffix נַפְשׁוֺתָם 2Sam 23:17 +; נַפְשֹׁתָם Num 17:3 +: — 1 = that which breathes, the breathing substance or being = ψυχή , anima, the soul, the inner being of man: a. distinguished from בָּשָׂר וְעַד מִנֶּפֶשׁ ׃בָּשָׂר Isa 10:18 ; הַבָּשָׂר עִם הַנֶּפֶשׁ Deut 12:23 ; from שְׁאֵר Prov 11:17 ; from בֶּטֶן body Psa 31:10 . b. both the inner נפשׁ and the outer בשׂר are conceived as resting on a common substratum: תֶּאֱבָֽל׃ עָלָיו וְנַפְשׁוֺ יִכְאָ֑ב עָלָיו בְּשָׂרוֺ אַךְ Job 14:22 only his flesh upon him is in pain, and his soul upon him mourneth ; compare Psa 42:5 ; 42:7 ; 131:2 ; Job 30:16 ; Lam 3:20 [see עַל 1d ], all poetical (compare 6c ). c. ׳נ departs at death and returns with life: מֵתָה כִּי נַפְשָׁהּ בְּצֵאת וַיְתִי Gen 35:18 (E) and it came to pass when her soul was going forth ( for she died ); נַפְשָׁהּ נָָֽפְחָה Jer 15:9 she breathed out her soul , compare 1Kin 17:21-22 , Job 11:20 ; 31:39 . d. often desired that the נפשׁ may be delivered: from Sh®°ôl Psa 16:10 ; 30:4 ; 49:16 ; 86:13 ; 89:49 ; Prov 23:14 ; from שַׁחַת , the pit of Sh®°ôl , Isa 38:17 ; Job 33:18 , 22 , 28 , 30 . 2 The נפשׁ becomes a living being: by God's breathing חיים נשׁמת into the nostrils of its בשׂר ; of man Gen 2:7 (J); by implication of animals also 2:19 (J); so Psa 104:29 ; 104:30 ; compare 66:9 ; man is חַיָּה נֶפֶשׁ , a living, breathing being Gen 2:7 (J); elsewhere חיּה נפשׁ always of animals 1:20 , 24 , 30 ; 9:12 , 15 , 16 (all P), Ezek 47:9 ; so החיּה נפשׁ Gen 1:21 ; 9:10 (both P), Lev 11:10 , 46 (H); השׁרצת נפשׁ 11:46 (H); חי כל נפשׁ Job 12:10 . נפשׁ is frequently used with the verb ׃חיה נפשׁ וחיתה Gen 12:13 ; 19:20 (both J), 1Kin 20:32 (E), Psa 119:175 ; Jer 38:17 , 20 ; נַפְשְׁךָ חֵי 1Sam 1:26 ; 17:55 ; 20:3 ; 25:26 ; 2Sam 11:11 ; 14:9 ; 2Kin 2:2 , 4 , 6 ; 4:30 (all J E); compare נ ׳יְחַיֶּה 1Kin 20:31 (E), Ezek 18:27 ; Psa 22:30 ; also Gen 19:19 ; Isa 55:3 ; Prov 3:22 . 3 The נפשׁ (without חיה noun or verb) is specified: a. a living being whose life resides in the blood [so in Arabic We Skizzen iii. 217 G. Jacob Arab. Dicht. iv. 9 f. ] (hence sacrificial use of blood, and its prohib. in other uses; first in D), Deut 12:23-24 , only be sure that thou eat not the blood, for the blood is the living being ( הַנֶּפֶשׁ הוּא הַדָּם ); and thou shalt not eat the living being with the flesh ( הַבָּשָׂר עִם הַנֶּפֶשׁ ); thou shalt pour it upon the earth as water ; this is enlarged in H, Lev 17:10-11 , 12 , 14 and in P Gen 9:4-5 , compare Jer 2:34 . b. a serious attack upon the life is an attack upon this inner living being 2Sam 1:9 ; Jer 4:10 ; Jonah 2:6 ; Psa 69:2 ; 124:4 ; 124:5 ; Job 27:3 . c. נפשׁ is used for life itself 171 t., of animals Prov 12:10 , and of man Gen 44:30 (J); נפשׁ תחת נפשׁ life for life Exod 21:23 (E), Lev 24:18 (H), 1Kin 20:39 , 42 ; 2Kin 10:24 ; תחתיכם נפשׁנו Josh 2:14 (J); בנפשׁ נפשׁ Deut 19:21 ; בנפשׁ for the life of 2Sam 14:7 ; Jonah 1:14 ; בכף נפשׁ שׂם put life in one's own hand Judg 12:3 ; 1Sam 19:5 ; 28:21 ; Job 13:14 ; למות נפשׁו חרף Judg 5:18 risked his life to die ; בנפשׁ at the risk of life Num 17:3 (P), 2Sam 23:17 = 1Chr 11:19 (twice in verse), 1Kin 2:23 ; Prov 7:23 ; Lam 5:9 ; נפשׁ בקּשׁ Exod 4:19 (J), 1Sam 20:21 ; 22:23 (twice in verse); 23:15 ; 25:29 ; 2Sam 4:8 ; 16:11 ; 1Kin 19:10 , 14 ; Jer 4:30 ; 11:21 ; 19:7 , 9 ; 21:7 ; 22:25 ; 34:20-21 , 38:16 ; 44:30 (twice in verse); 46:26 ; 49:37 ; Psa 35:4 ; 38:13 ; 40:15 ; 54:5 ; 63:10 ; 70:3 ; 86:14 ; Prov 29:10 ; נ ׳שׁאל 1Kin 3:11 2Chr 1:11 ; 1Kin 19:4 = Jonah 4:8 ; נפשׁ הִכָּה smite mortally Gen 37:21 (J), Deut 19:6 , 11 ; Jer 40:14-15 , נ ׳לקח 1Kin 19:4 ; Jonah 4:3 ; Psa 31:14 ; Prov 1:19 ; מִמָּוֶת נֶפֶשׁ הִצִּיל deliver life from death Josh 2:13 ; Psa 33:19 ; Psalm 56:14; נפשׁ מלּט 1Sam 19:11 ; 2Sam 19:6 (4 t. in verse); 1Kin 1:12 (twice in verse); Jer 48:6 ; 51:6 , 45 ; Ezek 33:5 ; Amos 2:14-15 , Psa 89:49 ; 116:4 ; ׳נ פדה 2Sam 4:9 ; 1Kin 1:29 ; Psalm 34:23; Psa 49:16 ; 55:19 ; 71:23 ; נ ׳שׁמר 25:20 ; 97:10 ; Job 2:6 ; Prov 13:3 ; 16:17 ; 19:16 ; 22:5 . 4 The נפשׁ as the essential of man stands for the man himself: a. paraphrase for personal pronoun especially in poetry and ornate discourse, 70 t.; (1) נַפְשִׁי = me: נפשׁי תבא אל Gen 49:6 let me not enter (poem in J); נ ׳תָּמֹת ישׁרים מות Num 23:10 let me die , etc. (poem); נַפְשְׁי תָּמוֺת Judg 16:30 (J); נפשׁי אמרה Lam 3:24 I say . (2) נַפְשְׁךָ = thee: נַפְשֶׁ֑ךָ תַּחַת לְאֻמִּים Isa 43:4 peoples instead of thee ; לְנַפְשֵׁךְ אָֽמְרוּ 51:23 . (3) נַפְשׁוֺ = he: תלין בטוב נפשׁו Psalms he will not dwell in good circumstances . (4) נַפְשֵׁנוּ = we: יוֺקְשִׁים מִמַּח נִמְלְטָה כְּצִמּוֺר נַפְשֵׁנוּ Psa 124:7 . (5) נַפְשָׁם = they, them: הָלָ֑כָה בַּשְּׁבִי נַפְשָׁם Isa 46:2 they are gone into captivity ; לנפשׁם אוי 3:9 . b. = reflexive, self , 53 t.: נפשׁ על אסר bind oneself Num 30:3 ; 30:5 (twice in verse); 30:6 ; 30:7 ; 30:8 ; 30:9 ; 30:10 ; 30:11 ; 30:12 ; נ ׳לְעַנֹּת 30:14 to afflict oneself . (1) נַפְשִׁי = myself: נפשׁי אדע לא Job 9:21 I know not myself . (2) נַפְשְׁךָ = thyself: נ ׳שׁמר Deut 4:9 keep thyself . (3) נַפְשׁוֺ = himself: כנ ׳אהב 1Sam 18:1 , 3 ; 20:17 loved as himself . (4) נַפְשָׁהּ = herself: נ ׳צדּקה Jer 3:11 justified herself . (5) נַפְשָׁם = themselves: נ ׳הציל deliver themselves Isa 47:14 ; Ezek 14:14 , 20 . (6) נַפְשֹׁתֵיכֶם נַפְשְׁכֶם, = yourselves: נ ׳אַלתַּֿשִּׁאוּ Jer 37:9 deceive not yourselves , also 42:20 ; 44:7 ; נ ׳ענּה Lev 16:29 , 31 ; 23:27 , 32 ; Num 29:7 (P); לנ ׳נשׁמרתם Deut 4:15 ; Josh 23:11 (D). (7) נַפְשׁוֺתֵינוּ = ourselves: נ ׳על Jer 26:19 against ourselves . c. = person of man, individual, 144 t., first in D 2 ; especially in H, P, and kindred writers: (1) with אָדָם : ׳נ אדם Lev 24:17 opposed to ׳נ בהמה 24:18 (both H), and so ׳נ אדם human persons Num 31:35 , 40 , 46 (P) 1Chr 5:21 ; Ezek 27:13 . Elsewhere without אדם : ׳נ ברכה Prov 11:25 one who blesses ; ׳נ רְמִיָּה 19:15 idle person ; ׳נ נ ׳תחת person in place of person , Job 16:4 ; נ ׳על כמּר Exod 30:15-16 , Num 15:28 ; 31:50 (all P) Lev 17:11 (H). (2) נפשׁ = person, any one: Deut 24:7 ; 27:25 ; Prov 28:17 ; Ezek 18:4 (3 t. in verse); 33:6 ; elsewhere only H P: Lev 2:1 ; 4:2 , 27 ; 5:1-2 , 4 , 15 , 17 ; Leviticus 5:21; 7:18 , 20 , 21 , 25 , 27 ; 23:29-30 , (twice in verse); Num 5:6 ; 15:27 , 30 ; 19:22 ; 31:19 , 28 ; 35:11 , 15 , 30 (twice in verse); Josh 20:3 , 9 (all P), Lev 17:10 , 12 , 15 ; 20:6 (twice in verse); 22:6 , 11 (all H); מן הַהִוא הנ ׳נכרתה that person shall be cut off from: only in Gen 17:14 ; Exod 12:15 , 19 ; 31:14 ; Lev 7:20-21 , 27 ; Num 9:13 ; 15:30-31 , 19:13 , 20 (all P), Lev 19:8 ; 22:3 (both H). (3) נפשׁ collective for persons , in enumerations: Deut 10:22 ; Josh 10:28 , 30 , 32 , 35 , 37 (twice in verse); 10:39 ; 11:11 (all D 2 ) Jer 43:6 ; 52:29-30 , (twice in verse); Ezek 22:25 ; elsewhere only Gen 12:5 ; 46:15 , 18 , 22 , 25 , 26 (twice in verse); 46:27 (twice in verse); Exod 1:5 (twice in verse); 12:16 ; Num 31:35 , 40 (all P). (4) נְפָשׁוֺת persons Gen 36:6 ; Exod 12:4 ; 16:16 ; Num 19:18 (all P), Lev 18:29 ; 20:25 ; 27:2 (all H), 2Kin 12:5 ; Prov 11:30 ; 14:25 ; Ezek 13:18 (3 t. in verse); 13:19 (twice in verse); 13:20 (twice in verse); 17:17 ; 18:4 ; 22:27 ( נפשׁים 13:20 see above). (5) נפשׁ = deceased person , sometimes with מֵת נֶפֶשׁ מֵת, Num 6:6 (P), מֵת נַפְשֹׁת ( נֶפֶשׁ ᵑ6 ᵐ5 ) Lev 21:11 (H); usually without (ה)אדם נפשׁ מֵת, Num 9:6-7 , 19:11 , 13 (P); or simply נפשׁ , Lev 19:28 ; 21:1 ; 22:4 (all H) Num 5:2 ; 6:11 ; 9:10 (all P); elsewhere only Hag 2:13 . 5 נפשׁ = seat of the appetites , in all periods (46 t.) — a. hunger: ׳נ רְעֵבָה hungry soul Psa 107:9 ; Prov 27:7 ; with noun or verb of שׂבע satisfy Isa 56:11 ; 58:10 ; Jer 50:19 ; Ezek 7:19 ; Psa 63:6 ; 107:9 ; Prov 13:25 ; 27:7 ; לנ ׳מתוק 16:24 sweet to the taste . b. thirst: ׳נ עֲיֵפָה weary soul Prov 25:25 ; Jer 31:25 ; ׳נ עיפה כארץ Psa 143:6 ; נ ׳צמאה 42:3 ; 63:2 . c. appetite in General: בנ ׳אֹיְבַי עָלָיו יַקִּיפוּ Psa 17:9 my enemies compass me about with greed ; פִיהָ וּפָֽעֲרָה נַפְשָׁהּ שְׁאוֺל הִרְחִיבָה Isa 5:14 Sh®°ôl enlarged her appetite , etc., compare Hab 2:5 ; Prov 23:2 נֶפֶשׁ בַּעַל ; Ecclesiastes uses נפשׁ only in the sense of a, b, c ; the נפשׁ craves, lacks, and is filled with good things: Eccl 2:24 ; 4:8 ; 6:2-3 , 7 , 9 ; 7:28 . 6 = ׳נ seat of emotions and passions (151 t.) — a. desire: נ ׳אִוְּתָה soul desires Deut 12:20 ; 14:26 ; 1Sam 2:16 ; 2Sam 3:21 ; 1Kin 11:37 ; Job 23:13 ; Prov 13:4 ; 21:10 ; Micah 7:1 ; נ ׳תַּאֲוַת Psa 10:3 ; Isa 26:8 ; נ ׳אַוַּת Deut 12:15 , 20 , 21 ; 18:6 ; 1Sam 23:20 ; Jer 2:24 ; so also לנפשׁ according to one's desire Deut 21:14 ; Psa 78:18 ; Jer 34:16 ; כנפשׁ Deut 23:25 ; נפשׁנו האח ah, our desire Psa 35:25 ; בנפשׁ at one's desire 105:22 ; Ezek 16:27 ; בְדַבְּרוֺ ׳נ יָָֽצְאָה Song 5:6 ; נ ׳נשׂא lift up the soul, desire Deut 24:15 ; 2Sam 14:14 (read אליהם , not אלהים ), Psa 24:4 ; 25:1 ; 86:4 ; 143:8 ; Prov 19:8 ; Jer 22:27 ; 44:14 ; Hosea 4:8 . b. abhorrence, loathing: נ ׳געלה soul abhorreth Lev 26:11 , 15 , 30 , 43 (H) Jer 14:19 ; נ ׳וגם בי בחלה Zech 11:8 and their soul also fell a loathing against me . c. sorrow and distress: נ ׳מרי bitter, gloomy, discontented of soul Judg 18:25 (E) 2Sam 17:8 ; Job 3:20 ; Prov 31:6 ; נ ׳מר 1Sam 22:2 compare Job 7:11 ; 10:1 ; Isa 38:15 ; Ezek 27:1 ; נ ׳עָֽגְמָה Job 30:35 grieved ; נ ׳אגמי sad of soul Isa 19:10 ; נ ׳תבכה my soul shall weep Jer 13:17 ; ׳נ ירעה his soul trembleth Isa 15:4 ; נ ׳צרת distress of soul Gen 42:21 (E). d. joy: ׳נ תגיל my soul rejoiceth Psa 35:9 ; Isa 61:10 ; נ ׳שׂמּח rejoice the soul Psa 86:4 ; also 94:19 ; 138:3 ; Prov 29:17 . e. love: נ ׳אהבה my soul loveth Song 1:7 ; 3:1-2 , 3 , 4 ; נ ׳יְדִדוּת darling of my soul Jer 12:7 ; נ ׳דבקה ׳ב his soul clave unto Gen 34:3 (J), with אחרי Psa 63:9 ; ׳נ ׳ב חשׁקה soul is attached to Gen 34:8 (P). f. alienation, hatred, revenge: נ ׳תֵּקַע מן the soul is alienated from Jer 6:8 ; Ezek 23:17-18 , נ ׳נקעה מן 23:18 , 22 , 28 ; נ ׳שְׂנֻאי hated of soul 2Sam 5:8 (Qr); נ ׳שׂנאה Psa 11:5 ; Isa 1:14 . g. other emotions and feelings: נ ׳השׁיב bring back soul Lam 1:11 , 19 (i.e. revive, compare with שׁוּב 1Kin 17:21 f.), hence figurative refresh, cheer , 17:16 ; Psa 19:8 ; Prov 25:14 ; Ruth 4:15 ; נ ׳שׁובב Psa 23:3 ; נ ׳מַחְמַל your souls' compassion Ezek 24:21 ; נ ׳קצרה soul was impatient Num 21:4 (E), Judg 10:16 ; 16:16 ; Zech 11:8 ; נ ׳אאריך כי that I should prolong my patience Job 6:11 אתנֿ ׳ידעתם הגר ye know the feeling of the stranger Exod 23:9 (R D ). 7 נפשׁ is used occasionally for mental acts + לבב (see 10 ); possibly also alone, owing to unconscious assimilation by late writers; but most, if not all, examples may be otherwise explained: מאד ידעת נפשׁי Psa 139:14 my soul knoweth well (or I know well ; compare 4a ); נ ׳דעת טוב לא בלא Prov 19:2 that the soul be without knowledge is not good (but RVm desire without knowledge , compare 6a ); לנ חכמה ׳דעה 24:14 know wisdom for thy soul (or according to thy desire , compare 6a ); בנ תדמי ׳אל Est 4:13 think not in thy soul (or in thyself , compare 4b ); ׳בג שׁער כמו Prov 23:7 as he reckoneth in his soul (but RV in himself , compare 4b ); נ תאמר ׳מה 1Sam 20:4 (but AV RV following ᵐ5 ἐπιθυμεῖ = תְּאַוֶּה ; see 6a ). 8 נפשׁ for acts of the will is dubious: נפשׁכם ישׁ אם ( את ) if it is your purpose Gen 23:8 (P) 2Kin 9:15 (or if it is your desire , 6a ); נ ׳בחרה my soul chooseth Job 7:15 ; נ ׳מאנה my soul, refuseth 6:7 ; Psa 77:3 ; ׳נ חפצה their soul delighteth in Isa 66:3 ; ׳נ רצתה my soul delighteth in 42:1 ; (all perhaps emotional, 6b, d, g ). 9 נפשׁ = character is still more dubious: נ ׳לאֹיָָֽֿשְׁרָה בּוֺ Hab 2:4 his soul is not right in him (but ᵐ5 οὐκ εὐδοκεῖ ἡ ψυχή μου ἐν αὐτῷ [ εὐδοκεῖ = רצתה ], see 6 ); מְטֻמָּאָה לאֹ נַפְשִׁי Ezek 4:14 my soul hath not (or I have not , 4a ) been polluted. 10 ׳נ in D, when used with לבב , is assimilated to it, and shares with it the meanings of 7, 8, 9 ; and so in later writers influenced by D (unless we may think that ׳ל is used of intellect, while ׳נ is used of the feelings): thus, נפשׁ ובכל לבב בכל (see לבב ): with דרשׁ Deut 4:29 ; 2Chr 15:12 ; עשׂה Deut 26:16 ; אהב 6:5 ; 13:4 ; 30:6 ; ידע Josh 23:14 ; עבד Deut 10:12 ; 11:13 ; Josh 22:5 ; בקלו שׁמע Deut 30:2 ; אל שׁוב 30:10 ; 1Kin 8:48 2Chr 6:38 ; 2Kin 23:25 ; מצות שׁמר 23:3 2Chr 34:31 ; לפני הלך 1Kin 2:4 ; and Deut 11:18 ; 1Sam 2:35 ; 1Chr 22:19 ; 28:9 ; Jer 32:41 ; Psalm 13:8; Prov 2:10 ; 24:12 . Note. — In three cases is Generally found closer approach to supposed radical meaning breath: — a. נפשׁ מעצת רעהו ומתק לב ישׂמח וקטרת שׁמן Prov 27:9 . Ges (after Döderlein) renders a. נ ׳מעצת more than odorous trees , so later edds., even Buhl; but ᵑ9 De SS transpose) נ ׳וּמֶתֶק רֵעֵהוּ מֵעֲצַת . ᵐ5 Hi Bi ומתקרעה = the soul is rent asunder by cares . In any case נפשׁ is || לב , compare 10. b. תְּלַהֵט גֶּחָלִים נַפְשׁוֺ Job 41:13 his breath kindleth coals (of the crocodile).The piece is one of the latest in the book; primitive meaning hardly in such a passage; context favours reference to passion or fury ; perhaps below 6f , his passion or fury kindleth coals. c. הַנֶּפֶשׁ בָּתֵּי Isa 3:20 perfume boxes ; meaning evident from context; but not necessarily scent (breath)-boxes ; may be 6a , boxes of desire , or 5 , boxes exciting the sense of smell; = smelling boxes or bottles. No sufficient evidence in Biblical Hebrew, therefore, for meaning breath, odour . — See, for complete study of נֶפֶשׁ (all passages), Br JBL 1897, 17 ff .
